description: Microphone and audio, through shortcuts or a direct connection
setting.mute.label: Mute microphone
setting.mute.help: The shortcut the app presses. It uses F13–F24, keys no keyboard has, so it never clashes with anything.
setting.deafen.label: Deafen
step.1: In Discord, open **User Settings** (the gear next to your name) and go to **Keybinds**.
step.2: Click **Add a Keybind** and choose the **Toggle Mute** action.
step.3: Click **Record Keybind** and press the Deck key with the **Mute microphone** action. No key yet? Click **Send in 5 s** under Mute microphone here and go back to Discord in time.
step.4: Add another keybind with the **Toggle Deafen** action and record it the same way (Discord should show **{deafen}**).
step.5: Done. No Client ID or login needed: the app presses these shortcuts for you, and they work even with Discord minimized.
action.mute.label: Mute microphone
action.mute.help: Uses the keybind you created in Discord. Set it up in Settings › Integrations.
field.keys.label: Shortcut (optional)
field.keys.help: Only in keyboard shortcuts mode. Leave empty to use the one from Integrations.
action.deafen.label: Deafen
action.deafen.help: Cuts the Discord sound (and the microphone with it), through the keybind you created in Discord.
action.keybind.label: Another Discord keybind
action.keybind.help: Presses an extra shortcut saved in the discord section of config.yaml.
field.name.label: Shortcut name
setting.mode.label: How to connect
setting.mode.help: Shortcuts need no account, but the key only guesses the state. With a Client ID the app talks to Discord directly and the keys show the real mute and deafen state.
setting.client_id.label: Client ID
setting.client_secret.label: Client Secret
setting.client_secret.help: Stays only in your config.yaml and is left out of exported backups.
step.rpc.1: Open **discord.com/developers/applications**, click **New Application** and give it any name (e.g.: D6).
step.rpc.2: In **OAuth2**, copy the **Client ID**. Click **Reset Secret** and copy the **Client Secret**.
step.rpc.3: Still in **OAuth2**, under **Redirects**, add **http://localhost** and save.
step.rpc.4: Paste both here. Discord opens a window asking for permission: click **Authorize**. It only asks once.
step.rpc.5: Done: the keys follow the real state, even when you mute with the mouse. It only works with the Discord account that created the application.
field.bind.label: Shortcut
step.more: For the other Discord actions (push to talk, streamer mode, soundboard, clips…), drag the action onto a Deck key: the editor makes a shortcut just for it and shows how to record it in Discord.
action.ptt.label: Push to talk
action.ptt.help: Your microphone stays open while you hold the Deck key.
action.ptt.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Push to Talk (Normal)”, click Record Keybind
action.ptt_priority.label: Push to talk (priority)
action.ptt_priority.help: Talks as priority speaker while you hold the key: the others get quieter. Needs the Priority Speaker permission on the server.
action.ptt_priority.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Push to Talk (Priority)”, click Record Keybind
action.push_to_mute.label: Push to mute
action.push_to_mute.help: Mutes your microphone while you hold the Deck key.
action.push_to_mute.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Push to Mute”, click Record Keybind
action.vad_priority.label: Voice activity priority
action.vad_priority.help: Priority speaker while you hold the key, using voice activity.
action.vad_priority.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Voice Activity Priority”, click Record Keybind
action.toggle_vad.label: Voice activity or push to talk
action.toggle_vad.help: Switches the input mode between voice activity and push to talk.
action.toggle_vad.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Toggle VAD”, click Record Keybind
action.streamer_mode.label: Streamer mode
action.streamer_mode.help: Turns streamer mode on or off (hides personal information).
action.streamer_mode.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Toggle Streamer Mode”, click Record Keybind
action.voice_chat.label: Voice channel chat
action.voice_chat.help: Opens or closes the text chat of the voice channel.
action.voice_chat.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Toggle Voice Channel Chat”, click Record Keybind
action.overlay_lock.label: Lock the overlay
action.overlay_lock.help: Locks or unlocks the in-game overlay.
action.overlay_lock.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Toggle Overlay Lock”, click Record Keybind
action.overlay_chat.label: Overlay chat
action.overlay_chat.help: Opens the chat in the in-game overlay.
action.overlay_chat.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Activate Overlay Chat”, click Record Keybind
action.nav_back.label: Navigate back
action.nav_back.help: Goes back to the previous screen in Discord.
action.nav_back.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Navigate Back”, click Record Keybind
action.nav_forward.label: Navigate forward
action.nav_forward.help: Goes forward to the next screen in Discord.
action.nav_forward.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Navigate Forward”, click Record Keybind
action.switch_channel.label: Join a voice channel
action.switch_channel.help: Joins the voice channel you pick when creating the keybind in Discord. One key per channel.
action.switch_channel.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Switch To Voice Channel”, click Record Keybind
action.disconnect.label: Leave the voice channel
action.disconnect.help: Disconnects from the voice channel you're in.
action.disconnect.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Disconnect From Voice Channel”, click Record Keybind
action.soundboard.label: Open the soundboard
action.soundboard.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Open Soundboard”, click Record Keybind
action.soundboard_hold.label: Soundboard while held
action.soundboard_hold.help: The soundboard stays open while you hold the Deck key.
action.soundboard_hold.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Open Soundboard (Hold)”, click Record Keybind
action.save_clip.label: Save clip
action.save_clip.help: Saves a clip of the last moments (Clips turned on in Discord).
action.save_clip.hint: In Discord › Keybinds, click Add a Keybind, choose “Save Clip”, click Record Keybind
